content: This medication, known as Menotropins (brand name Menopur), is used to treat specific fertility issues in women. It contains follicle-stimulating hormone (FSH) and luteinizing hormone (LH), which stimulate healthy ovaries to produce eggs. Administration Instructions: Before starting this medication, carefully read the patient information leaflet and instructions provided by your pharmacist. Consult your healthcare provider for guidance on preparation and administration. This medication is administered via subcutaneous injection, typically in the abdomen, as directed by your doctor. The dosage and duration of treatment depend on your medical condition, response to therapy, and any other medications you may be taking. The solution should be used immediately after mixing. Inspect the product for particles or discoloration before use; do not use it if either is present. Clean the injection site with rubbing alcohol before each dose, and rotate injection sites to minimize skin injury. Avoid rubbing the injection site after administration to reduce bruising. Use this medication exactly as prescribed to achieve the best results, and administer it at the same time each day to maintain consistency. Potential Side Effects: Common side effects may include headache, mild abdominal pain or bloating, redness or pain at the injection site, breast tenderness, or dizziness. This medication has been prescribed because your doctor has determined that the benefits outweigh the risks. However, it may cause ovarian hyperstimulation syndrome (OHSS), a condition that can occur during or after treatment. In rare cases, severe OHSS can lead to sudden fluid accumulation in the abdomen, chest, or heart area. Serious allergic reactions to this medication are rare but possible. If you experience symptoms such as difficulty breathing, swelling, or severe dizziness, seek immediate medical attention. This list does not include all possible side effects. In the U.S., contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, consult your healthcare provider for guidance. Precautions: Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, other products containing FSH or LH, or any inactive ingredients that may cause allergic reactions. This medication may cause dizziness, and alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate this effect. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or performing tasks requiring alertness until you can do so safely. Limit alcohol consumption. Multiple births (e.g., twins or triplets) may occur as a result of this treatment. Discontinue use if you become pregnant, as this medication must not be used during pregnancy. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk, so use caution if breastfeeding. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of this medication or increase the risk of serious side effects. Keep a list of all products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal supplements, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Overdose: In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Monitoring and Lifestyle Recommendations: While using this medication, regular medical and laboratory tests (e.g., blood hormone levels such as estradiol, vaginal ultrasounds) are necessary to monitor your progress and prevent complications. Attend all scheduled appointments. Lifestyle changes, such as limiting alcohol and quitting smoking, may enhance the effectiveness of this treatment. Missed Dose: It is crucial to use this medication on a fixed schedule as prescribed. If you miss a dose, contact your doctor or pharmacist immediately for instructions. Storage: Store this medication in the refrigerator or at room temperature, away from light. Do not freeze or store it in the bathroom. Properly discard expired or unused medication as instructed by your healthcare provider. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless directed to do so. Important Note: This summary does not contain all possible information about this product. It does not guarantee that the medication is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare provider for complete information tailored to your specific health needs.
